section: 14. Dragon Slaying Battle: Bow and Arrow and Vital Points
description: The investigators work together to aim silver arrows at the dragon's vital points, confirming the tattoo location. The "Dragon Slaying" battle nears its end.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The two severely wounded knights possess a golden spirit, but their bodies tell them that emotions are useless in the face of reality. Both are now within two meters of the crossbows. The moment their attacks miss, the archers expressionlessly take half a step back, quickly draw their bows and nock arrows. The cold arrowheads uniformly aim at the exposed chests and throats of the two. The taut bowstrings hum in the air. The next second, the arrow volley is released; the whistling of the arrows cutting through the air is sharp as the whisper of death. Iron-gray streaks of cold light tear through the air, heading straight for the vital points of the two wounded!

conversation.text: Amidst the sharp whistling of arrows cutting through the air, an iron arrow slams hard into player7's chest. The arrowhead strikes the metal rings of the chainmail, emitting a piercing clang. The arrowhead fails to fully penetrate, but the impact still sends player7 staggering backward, crashing heavily against the ruined altar. Although the chainmail blocks a fatal piercing, his ribs may be fractured, and whether the arrowhead has injured his lungs remains unknown. Cold sweat trickles down his temple, mixing with blood and grime, and his complexion visibly turns ashen.
